aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable test evidence but the changed-factor and outcome grouping are not reliable enough for Ask AI.
issues: Primary factor is ambiguous; baseline is not explicit.
Drop Test Manual/Auto are test modes, not material changes.
Cleaning conditions are mixed into one broad changed condition.
Several measurement outcomes appear derived from headers, not data rows.
Evidence includes broad/header rows and omits visible support for key stats.
requiredUserQuestions: Is this report comparing Primer, E100B-006, and Ethanol cleaning, or validating one combined process?
correctionPlan: Define changed factor as cleaning/chemical treatment only.
Keep Manual/Auto, bond type, test section, date, and model as subgroup context.
Rebuild outcomes from actual data rows for decap, tension, function, and drop tests.
Remove header-derived measurement statistics unless data rows support them.
Use concise citations to purpose, condition rows, result rows, and decision rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficiently targeted for final evidence.
